description: Replace one connector tool definition by its id. This replaces the definition rather than patching it, so send the whole request_definition you want it to end up with - read mba_get_connector_tool first. Known limitation: path_parameters, query_parameters and headers are NAME-TO-SCHEMA OBJECTS, not arrays - write {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, never [{"name": "order_id", ...}]. And every {brace} token in `path` must have a matching key in path_parameters, or the definition is rejected.
